weaknesses.what: Title "01:54 の会議" is only an elapsed-time label, not a real meeting name/source, and there is no indicator of audio origin (mic vs system vs specific app).
weaknesses.fix: Show the actual meeting/calendar title when available and a small badge naming the audio source (e.g. mic, system audio, Zoom).

weaknesses.what: The dark recording-control pill floats above and overlaps the main card's top edge, reading as a separate floating toolbar rather than part of the same surface.
weaknesses.fix: Dock the recording controls into the main card's own header/title bar instead of an overlapping floating pill.

weaknesses.what: "AI が見ている資料" gives no visible content, count, or empty-state message, so it's unclear if any material is attached.
weaknesses.fix: Show attached document names/thumbnails when present, or an explicit "資料なし" state when empty.

weaknesses.what: Meeting title is only a generic time stamp ('01:54 の会議') with no participant, calendar event name, or source app shown.
weaknesses.fix: Show the actual meeting/calendar title and a small source-app icon (Zoom/Meet/Teams/system audio) next to the recording indicator.

weaknesses.what: The floating top control capsule is visually detached (separate rounded shape, gap, and shadow) from the main content panel below it.
weaknesses.fix: Either merge the toolbar into the same rounded container as the panel or reduce the visual separation (matching radius, background, shadow) so it reads as one continuous surface.

weaknesses.what: 'AI が見ている資料' gives no visible file name, thumbnail, or explicit empty state, so it's unclear whether material exists.
weaknesses.fix: Show the referenced document's name/icon when present, or an explicit '資料なし' state when nothing is attached.

weaknesses.what: Meeting identity is generic ('01:54の会議') with no participant names, room, or calendar reference visible. Audio source is unlabeled.
weaknesses.fix: Show meeting title, participants, or calendar details; label audio input source (microphone, browser tab, etc.)

weaknesses.what: Waiting states ('待っています...', 'まだ発話がありません') don't explain what happens next or how to proceed if nothing is detected.

weaknesses.what: The floating control bar's purpose and primary actions are visually separated from the main content, making it unclear what users should focus on first.

weaknesses.what: Meeting label is a duration/timestamp ('01:53 の会議'), not the actual meeting name or source app

weaknesses.what: 'AI が見ている資料' link gives no visible document name, icon, or count, so presence of source material is unverifiable

weaknesses.what: Multiple sections (transcript, 決まったこと, やること) all show near-duplicate 'を待っています…' placeholder copy, making the screen feel empty/redundant

weaknesses.what: Meeting is identified only by a generic timestamp title ('01:53 の会議'), with no meeting name, participants, or source app shown.

weaknesses.what: 'AI が見ている資料' gives no visible evidence of any material — no file name, icon, or count — so it reads as an inert label rather than live status.

weaknesses.what: The floating toolbar pill at the top overlaps the main panel's edge and has its own rounded shape/shadow, reading as a separate floating window stacked on top rather than part of the same surface.

weaknesses.fix: Merge into a single decisions/actions area, or visually distinguish the button's role (e.g., 'jump to' vs. a separate feature) from the panel content.

weaknesses.what: Status message '聞いています...' repeats earlier statement about listening

weaknesses.what: Right panel is mostly empty; unclear if this is waiting state or placeholder

weaknesses.what: No visual indication of data flow — unclear how left panel (input) connects to right panel (analysis output)

weaknesses.what: No source/platform/audio indicator; title is just an auto-generated timestamp, not a real meeting identity

weaknesses.what: Bottom action buttons are disabled with no explanation of why or when they become active

weaknesses.what: Floating pill toolbar overlapping the panel top edge reads as a separate layer rather than fused chrome

weaknesses.what: Audio source is ambiguous — unclear if recording device input, participant feed, or meeting stream

weaknesses.what: Meeting is identified only by a generic timestamp ('01:54 の会議') with no link to an actual calendar event, app window, or participant list, so a first-time user can't tell which real-world meeting this is.

weaknesses.what: The only meeting identifier is '01:54 の会議', a generic elapsed-time label with no calendar title, participant names, or source app shown.
